description: This file defines a polymorphic Card component and its subcomponents (CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, CardFooter) for use in a React project. The components are styled with utility classes and support flexible HTML tag selection.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A polymorphic React component that renders different HTML tags based on the 'as' prop, with applied styling.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: A styled container component for the header section of a card.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: A styled heading component used within a card.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: A styled container for the main content of a card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: A styled container for the footer section of a card.
